title: Keep Heuristics Honest
story: ION found a heuristic that promises a short route through a solid crater.
lesson: An admissible heuristic never exceeds the true remaining cost and never goes negative. Supplied distances are trusted fixtures.
objective: Return sorted node IDs whose heuristic is negative, greater than its true distance, or missing. Ignore heuristic entries outside distances.
hint: Iterate the distance dictionary and test each estimate against [0, distance].
